fields.Name: Thailand Luban Workshop
fields.Partner Institution: Tianjin Bohai Vocational Technical College; Tianjin Railway Technical and Vocational College (Railway Center, 2018)
fields.Notes and Additional Information: World's first LW, opened Mar 8, 2016. Railway Center (high-speed rail maintenance, signaling) added Jul 20, 2018. Sources: MOE (moe.gov.cn) 2018; Xinhua Oct 2026.

data_quality_notes: The CI master sheet has 583 data rows; its Notes & Sources tab claims 589. These figures are retained as a source discrepancy.
The CI regional tabs contain 547 substantive CI-name rows and repeat/variant records; only exact normalized name-country matches were merged. 3 regional-only CI names were added.

The CI starter-coordinate workbook has 199 coordinate rows. 158 conservative same-country unique matches were retained on canonical records; 41 unmatched or ambiguous rows are kept as leads. Team coordinates are not independently checked. The Baruch College lead’s source coordinates conflict with its stated U.S. host and are preserved only as a claim; the mappable coordinates are withheld pending source reconciliation.
The detailed Luban sheet has 38 entries, while the separate active-name list has 40; they remain separate because labels/hosts are not consistently reconcilable.
Only 3 of 38 detailed Luban rows report any social-media frequency, and no per-workshop last-post dates were supplied.

American Spaces status labels are assumed for map display, not independently verified current status. The supplied directory has no per-location last-post dates. The U.S. Department of State describes a network of over 700 locations in 140 countries, so the 559-row workbook is not a complete current census.
Team-reported overlap claims and program-level interpretations are kept as leads, never imported as verified relationships or treated as computed distance.

For the Côte d’Ivoire and Madagascar team overlap claims, the workbooks assert 0 km/same institution or same university despite differing supplied coordinates. Map distances are recomputed from coordinates and must not reuse those assertions.

Selective public spot checks found a 2026 event report for Algiers 2, a March 2026 host-university notice for Moi University CI, an August 2025 Ethiopia Luban event, and a December 2025 American Corner Moi partner report. One instructor claimed weekly AI sessions at Algiers ACCA, but completed sessions were not independently counted. These examples are not representative cadence estimates or status decisions.

Map status is normalized from each original workbook label (for example, Active/Open/In Operation → active; Closed/Temporarily Closed → closed; TBD/Unspecified → unknown). Raw labels are retained. The assumption is not independent confirmation of current operation.

web_publication_audit.method: One web search query for every bundled network row, plus a targeted alternate-name query when the first results yielded no dated or attributable page. Search results were checked on 2026-10-29. Exact dates are taken only from publication metadata or date-coded source URLs; dates in result text and search-engine age labels are reported separately.
web_publication_audit.caveat: Search indexing is incomplete and may favor network-level or third-party mentions. The evidence does not prove a location’s current status or guarantee the last item posted by its own account. Registry status remains unknown until the cited source is reviewed.
